name: Nin Online
storyline:
The world of Nin Online is set in a turbulent era where powerful ninja villages vie for survival and dominance. After a great war, the ninja world enters a fragile peace. Each Hidden Village trains new generations of shinobi to defend its people, uphold its honor, and expand its influence.

As a young ninja, the player begins their journey in one of these villages, taking on missions, learning powerful jutsu, and forging bonds with comrades. But the world is far from safe—rogue ninja, rival villages, and looming conspiracies threaten the balance. Players rise through the ranks of their village, shaping their destiny as protectors, mercenaries, or even feared enemies.

At its core, the story is about the struggle between peace and conflict, loyalty and betrayal, as every ninja carves their path in a living world of alliances, wars, and legends.
summary: Fight and train with powerful Jutsu to rise through the ranks of your hidden village in a ninja open-world MMORPG. Nin Online combines roleplaying systems with intense real-time combat. Warning: This is a very hardcore RPG!
